patch.why: No OR passage places the Reserve Brigade on July 1. Merritt (R340) prints the encampment near Mechanicstown from June 29, two days of picketing there, and the march to Emmitsburg on the 2d; the Itinerary (R007) agrees on July 2. Buford's dispatch of 10.30 p. m. June 30 (R337) places the brigade at Mechanicstown. The July 1 position is read as Mechanicstown (no movement recorded in between), but Pleasonton's July 1 order to Merritt (D0988) to fall back after the infantry have left Emmitsburg does not state where Merritt was, and pickets may have been nearer Emmitsburg.
